svg.title: Complementary-Rank Siegel–Weil Exchange and the Commuting Theta Square in Stage 05
svg.desc: Side-by-side two-panel editorial mathematical diagram of the analytic foundation of Stage 05 of the Riemann Hypothesis proof. The Left Panel (cobalt, diamond markers) shows Complementary-Rank Siegel–Weil Exchange in TheoremForPartners.lean: a central Hermitian space W of even rank |n| = |a| + |b| with q negative signs (2q + 2 <= |n| <= 2 mu + 2q) is paired against complementary-rank partners: a larger space V of rank |a| = |b| + 2e (cobalt, diamond) and a smaller space V' of rank |b| (emerald, circle), with negative signs q_V + q_V' = q. Matched functions Phi (supported on the last |a| rows of k^{-1}) and Psi (supported on the first |b| columns of k) modulo m satisfy AreMatched: Phi(x) = chi(det k) Psi(y) with x y = 0. The flagship result New.Exchange.exchange_identity equates the theta integral over [U(V)] at (x, Phi) to c times the theta integral over [U(V')] at (v, Psi) pointwise on U(W), with ||c||^2 = C L_*(e) != 0 where C > 0 and the Schwartz vector x are fixed before choosing m and nu, backed by constancy of equalRankThetaRatio on H direct-sum W via Fubini cancellation L_*(k) L_*(-k) = 1 where L_*(-k) = L_*(k)^{-1} (exists_equalRankThetaRatio_eq_const). An amber export note indicates that exchange_identity feeds OneSquare.lean inside Stage 05 and is exported directly to Stage 06 (06_one_lift/three_exchanges via ExplicitMatching). A central seesaw doubling bridge arrow labeled W = U_1 direct-sum U_2 connects the Left Panel to the Right Panel. The Right Panel (emerald, circle markers) shows The Commuting Theta Square in OneSquare.lean as a four-corner diamond with U_1 on the left, U_2 on the right, larger A of rank |n| + 2t at the top (cobalt, diamond), and smaller A' of rank |n| at the bottom (emerald, circle). The top route Theta_i(x) lifts U_1 to A then takes the transposed lift A to U_2 using column blocks of x, satisfying GL-equivariance Theta_i(g x) = chi_i(det g) Theta_i(x). The bottom route Theta'_i(y) takes the transposed lift U_1 to A' then lifts A' to U_2 using row blocks of y, satisfying Theta'_i(y g) = chi_i(det g) Theta'_i(y). The commutation identity one_square_identity_of_isEdgeFamily (SquareLaw) proves sum_y Psi'(y) Theta'_i(y) = (kappa / c) sum_x Psi(x) Theta_i(x) with ||c||^2 = C L_*(t) != 0. An explicit rust honesty callout at the bottom of the Right Panel states that OneSquare.lean proves kappa is independent of (i, nu, m, forms) via polynomial Fock density, but does NOT prove kappa != 0; non-vanishing is proved later in ChainNorms and NormOfChain via Rallis injectivity.

g.text: Siegel–Weil Exchange & the Commuting Theta Square
Both ∫[U(V)] θW,V & ∫[U(V')] θV',W yield functions on U(W)
AreMatched: Φ(x) = χ(det k) · Ψ(y) (k ∈ GLn(OE/𝔪))
x = last |a| rows of k−1, y = first |b| cols of k ⇒ x · y = 0
χ = residue char of tame ν (weight μ) · σ : b ⊕ a ≃ n
∫[U(V)] θW,V(x ⊗ Φ) dh = c · ∫[U(V')] θV',W(v ⊗ Ψ) dh
• C > 0 & Schwartz vector x fixed once before choosing (𝔪, ν)
• Backed by constancy of equalRankThetaRatio on H ⊕ W:
Fubini on rk 2k pos.-def. J cancels L*(k) · L*(−k) = 1
⇒ equal-rank ratio is a nonzero ν-independent constant.
Feeds OneSquare.lean (→ right) and exports directly to
OneSquare.lean · doubled seesaw space W = U1 ⊕ U2
◆ Top Θi(x): col blocks of x
● Bot Θ'i(y): row blocks of y
• κ ∈ ℂ is uniform across (i, ν, 𝔪, forms) via polynomial
▲ HONESTY NOTE · κ ≠ 0 IS NOT PROVED HERE
OneSquare.lean proves κ is independent of (i, ν, 𝔪, forms),
but does NOT prove κ ≠ 0. Non-vanishing is proved later
in ChainNorms / NormOfChain via Rallis injectivity.
◆ Cobalt: larger partner / top route (V, A, Θi) │ ● Emerald: smaller partner / bottom route (V', A', Θ'i) │ ▲ Amber/Rust: seesaw bridge, export & κ caveat
